claims: scanner output, SARIF-like results, crash log, and reporter notes under data/evidence/LAB-501..LAB-504/
conventions: LAB-5xx tickets are untriaged intake: root_cause_group is 'intake-unclassified' and source is 'synthetic-intake-queue' until triage confirms them against code
test_name is null when no existing test is linked to the ticket; it is never an empty string or a placeholder name
verification_status 'unverified_pending_triage' means not yet reviewed; 'not_reproduced_no_failing_test' means reported but no test reproduces it
severity is the tracked intake severity per devin/knowledge/vulnerability-sla-policy.md; scanner and reporter severities are recorded in the evidence files
every LAB-5xx ticket has an evidence directory data/evidence/<ticket>/ (checked by tools/audit_findings.py)
source_categories.disclaimer: Fictional scanners, reporters, workers, and incidents created for triage practice; not real findings, tools, or actual Lucid data. Evidence does not describe remediation.

claims: DEP-101, DEP-201, DEP-202, DEP-301 dependency tickets in data/findings.json
advisory IDs, aliases, CWEs, summaries, fixed versions, and severity ratings copied from public OSV records
conventions: one DEP-* ticket per (package, advisory) pinned in data/advisory_candidates.json; advisory_id is the GHSA ID and aliases (CVE, PYSEC) are kept in a separate aliases field
advisory_id, title, cwe, and aliases come from data/osv/<advisory_id>.json; cwe is the OSV database_specific.cwe_ids list

severity maps the OSV database_specific.severity (GitHub-reviewed rating: CRITICAL, HIGH, MODERATE, LOW) to critical/high/medium/low; sla_days follows devin/knowledge/vulnerability-sla-policy.md; severity_source names the record
reported_at is the UTC date of the OSV package/version query evidence (query_retrieved_utc in data/advisory_candidates.json)
language, repository, and owner come from the service (data/inventory.json); root_cause_group is dependency-<package>; test_name is null

verification_status for PyYAML is scanner-confirmed (pip-audit via OSV in data/evidence/dependency-scenario/) with reachability not demonstrated (yaml.safe_load is used; the advisory concerns full_load); express and snakeyaml are manifest pins matched to OSV records, not installed or scanned, reachability not assessed
tools/audit_findings.py requires every DEP-* advisory_id to have data/osv/<advisory_id>.json with a matching id; LAB-* tickets keep advisory_id null
source_categories.disclaimer: The pins are deliberate synthetic lab state in fictional services; the advisories are real public records about the upstream packages. Not real Lucid findings or actual Lucid data. Transitive dependencies were not evaluated.
